request.description:
Get All Users

Description:  
Fetches all users from the database.

Method:  
GET

Endpoint:  
/api/users

Authentication:  
Required

Response:  
Returns a list of all registered users.

Test Case 15 — Public Product Catalog Browsing

Description:  
Verifies that users can browse the product catalog without providing an authentication token.

Method:  
GET

Endpoint:  
/api/products

Authentication:  
Not Required

Expected Response:  
200 OK

Response:  
Returns the available products with their details.

request.description:
Test Case 16 — RBAC: Standard User Cannot Create Product

Description:  
Attempts to create a product using a standard user account.  
Standard users do not have permission to create products.

Method:  
POST

Endpoint:  
/api/products

Authentication:  
Required

Role:  
user

Expected Response:  
403 Forbidden

Test Case 17 — RBAC: Moderator Allowed to Create Product

Description:  
Creates a new product using an authenticated moderator account.  
Moderators have permission to create products.

Method:  
POST

Endpoint:  
/api/products

Authentication:  
Required

Role:  
moderator

Request Body:  
{  
"name": "Wireless Headphones",  
"description": "Bluetooth wireless headphones",  
"price": 2499,  
"category": "electronics",  
"inStock": true,  
"quantity": 25  
}

Expected Response:  
201 Created

Test Case 19 — RBAC: Moderator Cannot Delete Product

Description:  
Attempts to delete a product using an authenticated moderator account.  
Moderators do not have permission to delete products.

Method:  
DELETE

Endpoint:  
/api/products/:id

Authentication:  
Required

Role:  
moderator

Expected Response:  
403 Forbidden

Test Case 20 — RBAC: Admin Allowed to Delete Product

Description:  
Deletes a product using an authenticated admin account.  
Administrators have permission to delete products.

Method:  
DELETE

Endpoint:  
/api/products/:id

Authentication:  
Required

Role:  
admin

URL Parameter:  
id — The unique ID of the product to be deleted.

Expected Response:  
200 OK

Test Case 03 — Missing Required Fields

Description:  
Attempts to register a user without providing all required fields.

Expected Response:  
400 Bad Request

Test Case 04 — Register Standard User

Description:  
Registers a new standard user successfully.

Request Body:  
{  
"name": "Rahul Mangal",  
"email": "[rahul@example.com](https://mailto:rahul@example.com)",  
"password": "Password123",  
"role": "user"  
}

Expected Response:  
201 Created

Test Case 05 — Duplicate Email Blocked

Description:  
Attempts to register another user using an email address that already exists.

Expected Response:  
409 Conflict

Test Case 06 — Register Moderator User

Description:  
Registers a new moderator user successfully.

Request Body:  
{  
"name": "Moderator User",  
"email": "[moderator@example.com](https://mailto:moderator@example.com)",  
"password": "Password123",  
"role": "moderator"  
}

Expected Response:  
201 Created

Test Case 07 — Register Admin User

Description:  
Registers a new administrator user successfully.

Request Body:  
{  
"name": "Admin User",  
"email": "[admin@example.com](https://mailto:admin@example.com)",  
"password": "Password123",  
"role": "admin"  
}

Expected Response:  
201 Created

Test Case 08 — Wrong Password Rejection

Description:  
Attempts to log in with a valid email but an incorrect password.

Request Body:  
{  
"email": "[rahul@example.com](https://mailto:rahul@example.com)",  
"password": "WrongPassword"  
}

Expected Response:  
401 Unauthorized

Test Case 09 — Valid Login & Token Issue

Description:  
Authenticates the user with valid login credentials and returns a JWT token.

Request Body:  
{  
"email": "[rahul@example.com](https://mailto:rahul@example.com)",  
"password": "Password123"  
}

Expected Response:  
200 OK

Response includes:

- User information
    
- JWT authentication token

Test Case 10 — Get User Profile (/me)

Description:  
Fetches the profile of the currently logged-in user using a valid JWT token.

Method:  
GET

Endpoint:  
/api/auth/me

Authorization:  
Bearer

Expected Response:  
200 OK

Response:  
Returns the authenticated user's profile information.

Test Case 11 — Access without Bearer Token

Description:  
Attempts to access the user profile without providing a Bearer token.

Method:  
GET

Endpoint:  
/api/auth/me

Authorization:  
No token provided

Expected Response:  
401 Unauthorized

Test Case 12 — Update Profile Details

Description:  
Updates the name and email address of the currently authenticated user.

Method:  
PUT

Endpoint:  
/api/auth/updatedetails

Authorization:  
Bearer

Expected Response:  
200 OK

Response:  
Returns the updated user profile information.

Description:  
Verifies that the API server is running correctly and the required services are available.

Method:  
GET

Endpoint:  
/api/health

Authentication:  
Not Required

Expected Response:  
200 OK
